reviewer: Independent UI reviewer; read-only review, no historical scores reused

evidenceLevel.framework: React 19.2.0; existing project components and scoped CSS
evidenceLevel.basis: Actual view_image inspection of final screenshots, computed-style evidence, source review, independent ephemeral headless user actions.
evidenceLevel.independentContext: New ephemeral headless Playwright process/context, memory preview only; closed after diagnostics. No existing browser/profile/service controlled.
evidenceLevel.emptyEvidenceCorrection: Earlier mislabeled configured-state empty screenshots explicitly excluded. Final empty screenshots were viewed after replacement; final driver selects the external scenario control, waits for the empty title and asserts zero proxy records.
evidenceLevel.testStatus: Provided targeted Node log says 60/60; not independently rerun. Source mapping accepted for unchanged behavioral code after final PAC presentation change. Test quantity does not determine scores.

scoringPolicy.basis: Current sidebar navigation/configuration/rules/button design goals; no historical pixel matching, no historical score inheritance, no averaging to mask a failed dimension.
scoringPolicy.deductions: Each deduction below names observable residual behavior or presentation. Deferred Native/production/IME/size-matrix work is not promoted into this phase or treated as a current P0.

dimensions.name: 布局与密度
basis: Final profiles/rules use stable two-line rows: 66px first row and 67px divided rows, 12px vertical padding, 8px item/action gaps.
Computed settings content has one 12px gutter, 16px section gaps and zero child margins. Proxy modal has one 16px gutter, 12px field-group gaps and 8px label gaps.
Final PAC card independently measures grid columns 240px/76px, 67.4375px height, 34px actions; third action row is fixed. PAC content/form follows 16/12/8 spacing.

deductions.reason: Rule editor source context and first field label touch at a measured 0px boundary; this remaining group boundary lacks the intended spacing rhythm.

dimensions.name: 信息层级与可发现性
basis: No proxy-panel/manage business Tabs; gear opens settings, native selector exposes seven sections, separate close returns to panel.

Removing the mixed add menu did not remove subscription/local-client creation: persistent named shortcuts open the respective URL/port forms. Corrected empty state retains Add, import and both shortcuts.
PAC remains a named, counted advanced disclosure under routing, keyboard-expandable; it requires scrolling with configured records, but is not deleted or inaccessible.

deductions.reason: A named local-client Edit action loses entity context and lands on the general sources overview.
Unlabeled tray/down-arrow import affordance is also the conventional download symbol; first-use visual intent depends on hover/title.

dimensions.name: 视觉与可读性
basis: Actual final Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English profiles/add screenshots retain readable hierarchy and action labels; user-defined Chinese names in English are data, not untranslated chrome.
Muted text/icons independently compute rgb(83,100,126), body rgb(27,44,73), actions rgb(54,94,218), destructive icons rgb(174,61,75), with white/soft surfaces; icon focus ring is visibly distinct.
Primary Add/Save/Apply actions use explicit words. Profile/rule names and metadata have separate weight/size; long names truncate without pushing edit/delete outside their rows.

deductions.reason: The zero-gap rule-context/field transition weakens otherwise clear grouping.

dimensions.name: 操作/草稿/反馈
basis: Supplied final interaction driver exercises proxy dirty Cancel/X/Escape Keep/discard, PAC dirty navigation, rule editing/deletion and return focus; final screenshots visibly distinguish saving/selection from applying.
Independent final-candidate diagnostics confirmed local-source and subscription entry routes open real forms; no real proxy actions were performed.
Success/error labels and invalid-port handling have targeted evidence; existing generation/revision safeguards were read without expanding backend review.

deductions.reason: Source-editor Escape/Cancel clears entered subscription/local-client drafts without the Keep/discard flow used elsewhere.
Local-client row Edit requires finding the same item again in another view instead of editing the selected record.

dimensions.name: 键盘与焦点
basis: Supplied computed data shows visible icon controls at 34x34px with title and accessible name; focused import has a solid 2px outline, corroborated by final import-focus.png.

Proxy uses a native modal dialog, labeled fields and initial host focus; supplied interactions verify Enter save and return focus after dismissal. Rule action labels retain domain/scope and deletion restores a surviving neighbor.
Independent final diagnostics used real keyboard Escape; PAC summary remains a native keyboard-operable disclosure.

deductions.reason: Escape on a populated source form discards the draft immediately, contradicting the protected Escape path in other editors.
Truncated routing-target detail exposes its full value through title only for sighted users; no focus-triggered visual disclosure is provided.

dimensions.name: 组件复用与边界
basis: Settings retains canonical Button, OptionsPageHeader, FormField, ClearableInput and shared ProxyIcon; semantic FormField class is added without a second renderer or host API.
Scoped sidebar-settings.css owns affected layout above isolated legacy CSS; real computed spacing supports the single-owner claim. Final PAC uses a narrow project-owned class.

Business changes remain in projects/ai-proxy. Runtime/environment/managed-config and formal package changes were excluded from this UI change attribution; no permission or execution-world expansion observed in reviewed UI changes.

deductions.reason: Newly promoted source-entry flows still use their separate unconditional closeEditor lifecycle instead of the existing revision-aware draft-close pattern.

localClientEdit.action: Click 编辑 本地客户端 from profiles

steps: Fill name Unsaved local review and port 8123

issues.title: 订阅/本地客户端表单的 Escape 与取消绕过草稿保护
issues.risk: 已输入的名称、端口和订阅 URL 无提示丢失；来源表单与代理、规则、PAC 的保留/放弃交互不一致。该实现原已存在，本轮常驻来源入口直接抵达，不能据其他表单的保护推断它也受保护。
issues.reproduction: 最终冻结候选中，经记录订阅来源填写名称与URL，按Escape；或经添加本地客户端填写名称与8123端口，点取消。两者均关闭且无确认，重开名称为空。
issues.fix: 在项目 owner 内复用 revision-aware request-close 模式；显式取消、Escape及其他关闭入口共同检查 source-editor dirty，Keep保留全部输入，确认放弃后再 closeEditor；内部保存成功清理与路由同步清理保留独立语义。不要通过移除入口修复。
issues.verification: 分别验证订阅及本地表单的 Escape/Cancel：Keep仍打开且值不变；确认放弃才清理；干净关闭不确认；保存成功不重复确认。

issues.title: 本地客户端行的编辑图标没有直达所选记录
issues.risk: 图标及accessible name承诺编辑具体客户端，实际仅跳来源总览，端口表单不可见；多客户端时需要重新寻找对象。
issues.fix: 将目标endpoint身份传入已有SourcesPage本地编辑流程，复用openLocal(id)与现有dirty guard；如本轮不做直达，至少将文案/图标语义明确为管理本地客户端，避免冒充实体编辑。现有/local路由当前是新增，不能只改为该路由而丢失编辑身份。
issues.verification: 点击任一本地客户端行编辑，出现对应名称/协议/端口；取消返回原行并恢复焦点，多客户端不串身份。

issues.title: 导入入口仅显示易被理解为下载的图标
issues.risk: 截图中导入按钮没有可见文字，下箭头入托盘也常用于下载/导出；title/aria提供了辅助语义，但不解决首次扫视的辨识问题。它实际跳转导入与备份区，并非立即打开文件选择器。
issues.fix: 优先增加短文字“导入”/“Import”并保留title/aria；若坚持icon-only，使用更明确的文件导入造型并提供focus/hover可见的tooltip。无需恢复混合添加菜单。
issues.verification: 中英繁文字均清楚，键盘焦点可解释按钮目的，点击仍到既有导入区，不改变权限或立即覆盖配置。

issues.title: 规则编辑来源说明紧贴第一字段标签
issues.risk: rule-editor.png中“正在编辑已保存的规则”与网站字段标题挤在一起。独立测得说明底部到首label顶部为0px，容器为block，两者margin均0。
issues.fix: 在rulesEditor这一owner上设置grid和8px或12px gap分隔来源说明与form；保留form margin:0，不用子元素margin再次叠加。
issues.verification: computed source-to-first-field gap为所选8/12px，规则内部12/16px节奏不变。

issues.title: 省略的规则目标详情没有供明眼键盘用户查看的完整提示
issues.risk: 长目标名称与优先级被省略；完整title在small上，small不可聚焦。屏幕阅读器可读完整DOM文本，故不声称文本对辅助技术消失，但明眼键盘用户需额外进入编辑器查找。
issues.fix: 在现有可聚焦动作或记录上提供关联的focus/hover完整详情浮层，或允许选中/聚焦记录时展开第二行；保持两行默认密度并避免新增无意义Tab站点。
issues.verification: 不用鼠标也可查看完整目标和优先级，Escape可关闭提示，编辑/删除焦点及布局不受影响。

limitations: 本评审只写指定ui-review.json；不修改产品、README、DESIGN或其他证据，不提交、安装、构建正式包、切分支、运行真实代理或控制现有浏览器/服务。
内存预览交互不证明真实配置持久化、Chrome代理启停、PAC实际执行、订阅同步、Native或流量可达；均NOT_TESTED。
可见macOS Chrome、production、全CI、完整语义类型、IME、宽度/缩放矩阵未执行；按本阶段边界不恢复为当前P0。
颜色/焦点判断来自实际截图和选定控件的computed styles；没有执行全应用WCAG对比度、读屏或暗色审计。
供应的11组交互证据与独立探查互补，不能因其PASS或Node60/60宣称所有来源关闭路径已覆盖；UI-01正是现有检查未覆盖的真实用户路径。
独立诊断Chromium156与供应截图Chromium155版本不同；它是额外memory UI交互证据，不冒充同版本Native或production验收。

conclusion.summary: 最终候选在密度、三语可读性、PAC左右布局和公开边界上有充分改进；来源表单草稿会无提示丢失，本地编辑与导入可发现性仍有缺口，不能诚实宣布六维≥95。
